model_conventions.formal_meaning: The displayed normalized vote has a nonzero sum of logarithmic weights and belongs to [0,1] at each training example, so the source F:[0,1]->[0,1] can be evaluated. Individual weights may be positive, zero, or negative.
model_conventions.why_needed: These are the domains of the displayed quotient and of F. Requiring every error to be below one half was a stronger sufficient condition in the earlier formalization, not a necessary source correction.
